faq.a: Entrepreneurs at Play is a physician-founded program. It offers after-school enrichment, summer camp and a mixed-age microschool.
Children from local schools and homeschool families can join. Golf is for ages 8–12. Ask about ages and schedules for the other afternoons.
EP is based in the Omaha metropolitan area. A Lincoln location is coming soon.
Fees vary by program. [Email us](mailto:{{email}}) for current fees.
